record.category: shared seedbox with a permanent free tier

free_tier.stated: 'Need free seedbox? Try out our free limited feature seedbox.' Plan card: 'Sonicers Free 4 GB - FREE - Once you be a Sonicers, you will be credited 4 GB Storage. You can always upgrade anytime.'
free_tier.notes: the only permanent free seedbox tier found among debrid providers; 4 GB, not a trial

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; the free tier is capped at 4 GB total, which is smaller than most single video files

retention.stated: while the account exists; 'limited feature' is not defined further and no inactivity deletion is stated

egress.terms: 'Unlimited traffic, 10 GBPS Network, for as low as 2.15 Dollar'; torrents are converted to direct HTTP links ('Download converted torrent file by HTTP direct download link provides for you'). No byte allowance is published for any tier.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited claimed, on a 4 GB free tier

record.interface_detail: Retrieval is over generated HTTP direct-download links from the dashboard; remote upload pushes to Google Drive, OneDrive, DropBox and pCloud. No SFTP or FTP is named on the page.
record.tooling: Browser dashboard and HTTP direct links; remote upload to Google Drive/OneDrive/DropBox/pCloud; no CLI or API documented
record.chaining: A free 4 GB landing pad that turns a magnet into an HTTP link; too small to hold 1 TiB of monthly transfer, but it proves the pipeline before any payment

limits.value: 4 GB total storage on the free tier; a single file larger than the tier cannot be held

record.limits_note: The 4 GB storage is the binding fact and the vocabulary has no kind for total disk; it is filed as per-object-cap because on this tier object and total coincide.
record.binding_note: 4 GB holds nothing of value at 1 TiB/month; the free tier is a pipeline test, not capacity.

identity_cost.detail: A dashboard account ('Once you be a Sonicers') is required; no phone or document check is stated for the free tier.

record.reliability_note: The free tier is 'limited feature' without a definition, so what is disabled is discovered at signup; nothing is charged, so nothing is refunded either.
record.confidence_note: The free tier and its 4 GB are stated on the vendor's own home page read. A measured rung needs an account and a real transfer.

evidence.proved: 'Sonicers Free 4 GB FREE'; 'Unlimited traffic, 10 GBPS Network, for as low as 2.15 Dollar'; 'Download converted torrent file by HTTP direct download link'; paid tiers USD 3.95/50 GB, 5.95/100 GB, 10.95/350 GB

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 0 for 4 GB; paid Basic USD 5.95 for 100 GB = USD 59.50/TB/month
record.notes: This is the only permanent free seedbox in the sector, and 4 GB is two orders of magnitude below a usable working set: 1 TiB of monthly transfer would be 256 cycles. Sustained-rate conversion: unlimited claimed on '10 GBPS Network', but the 4 GB tier cannot hold 1 TiB of monthly transfer regardless of port. Potential constraints: the 4 GB cap, an unstated free-tier traffic cap, or a paywall on HTTP links; only the cap is stated.

extras.minimum_term: free tier permanent; paid tiers monthly
extras.apps: browser dashboard, torrent-to-HTTP conversion, remote upload to Google Drive/OneDrive/DropBox/pCloud
extras.trial_card_required: no card for the free tier
extras.trial_restock: free tier is standing, not restocked
